newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: Most yields fall on latest Saudi treasury bills.
newsitem.headline: Most yields fall on latest Saudi treasury bills.

text.p: Most yields dropped at this week's Saudi Arabian Monetary Agency offering of two billion riyals worth of one-month to one-year treasury bills.
Bankers said the yield on 28-day bills was unchanged at 5.8523 percent and the rate on 91-day bills decreased to 5.8971 percent from 5.9448 percent last week.
The yield on 182-day bills fell to 5.9617 percent from 5.9781 and 364-day paper dropped to 6.1121 percent from 6.1295.
One-month deposit rates were quoted at six, 5-7/8 percent, three months at 6-1/16, 5-15/16 percent, six months at 6-1/8, six percent and one year at 6-1/4, 1/8 percent.
The bills were priced at 99.54688, 98.53125, 97.07422 and 94.17969 respectively. -- Bahrain newsroom 973-524424
